notes.A: A statue and the start of the sign peek past an oversized stone ledge.
notes.B: The sign dominates, with a statue and a sliver of water. The skull is clipped.
notes.C: The flaming skull and a statue frame the street, with the sign cut off.
notes.D: The widest street view makes the fountain small and leaves much of the square dark.
notes.E: The tower and street give the fountain context. The left edge cuts into the monument.
notes.F: The fiery sky looms over the fountain ledge. The sign is nearly edge-on.
notes.G: The provisions shop faces the monument, whose sign and skull are cut off.
notes.H: The whole fountain composition reads clearly. The pool and right pedestal run off the frame.

monument.best: H shows the welcome sign, flaming skull, waterfall, and both statues alongside the street they belong to.
monument.lacks: The streets lack a clear destination. Repeated windows and dark storefronts give the square little identity beyond the fountain.
monument.fix: Build a lantern-lit cemetery gate at the far end of the street to give the square a destination tied to the Gravesend sign.

blind_name.name: Stone fountain in a courtyard
blind_name.why: A waterfall spills from a stone wall into a pool flanked by statues.
blind_name.odd: The buildings in the background are very dark.

notes.A: The ornate building across the street takes center stage, and the station is clipped.
notes.B: A corner storefront anchors the intersection, while the station’s blank side wall hides its entrance.
notes.C: The facing block frames the approach, but the station frontage runs off the right edge.
notes.D: Both arches, the clock and lamps establish the station, though the entrances look dark.
notes.E: The arch reveals a passage inside, but the tight crop loses the clock.
notes.F: The facade and brick side street set the scene, but empty paving dominates.
notes.G: The arches and lamps fill the frame, but the steep angle crops the clock.
notes.H: The station sits convincingly on the street, but the oblique view foreshortens its name.

station_front.best: The clock, full station name, twin arches and lamps read together, with the brick side street grounding the station.
station_front.lacks: The street has no visible sign of railway activity beyond the name and clock. The dark arches give arriving players little sense of where to go.
station_front.fix: Turn the main entrance into a lit ticket hall with a ticket window and departure board visible from the street.

blind_name.name: Train station entrance
blind_name.why: A large clock overlooks a stone entrance and lamplit forecourt beside rows of city buildings.
blind_name.odd: No station sign is visible, and the clock hands are hard to read.
